description: President announces a ban on exports of cooking oil and its raw materials from 28 April 2022
notes: H3: adverse policy shock for palm producers; connected firms are expected to lose less than unconnected peers, so the connected-minus-unconnected gap is positive. Announced Friday evening after the 15:00 close, so day 0 is Monday 2022-04-25. The scope was narrowed to RBD olein on the evening of 2022-04-26 and widened to CPO on the evening of 2022-04-27: steps of the same episode, outside [-1,+1] but inside [0,+2] and [0,+5], not listed separately. An Eid exchange closure from 2022-04-29 is recalled, not verified; the engine uses the exchange calendar.

description: President announces that palm oil exports reopen on 23 May 2022
notes: H3: favourable policy shock; connected firms are expected to gain more than unconnected peers. Earliest report 17:21 WIB, after the 15:00 close, so day 0 is Friday 2022-05-20.

description: Finance minister announces the palm oil export levy is cut to zero until 31 August 2022 (PMK 115/2022)
notes: H3: favourable policy shock; connected firms are expected to gain more. Announced on Saturday 2022-07-16 at the G20 meeting in Bali, so day 0 is Monday 2022-07-18. The regulation took effect on Friday 2022-07-15 and may have circulated that day, which [-1,+1] covers.

description: NasDem declares Anies Baswedan its 2024 presidential candidate while a member of the governing coalition
notes: H1: the party breaks with the president's camp, which weakens its place in the governing coalition; firms tied to NasDem are expected to lose relative to other firms. Morning announcement, before the close. No listed firm in the Phase 1 universe has a NasDem tie on this date.

description: Analog terrestrial television switched off in Greater Jakarta; two private groups' stations comply a day late
notes: H3: adverse policy shock for incumbent broadcasters; connected broadcasters are expected to lose less. Scheduled: the date was fixed on 2022-10-05 and the legal deadline dates from 2020, so anticipation_flag = 1. Switch-off at 24:00, after the close, so day 0 is 2022-11-03.

description: Golkar and PAN declare support for Prabowo Subianto's presidential bid
notes: H1: joining the leading candidate's camp raises the party's expected place in the next government; firms tied to Golkar are expected to gain relative to other firms. Sunday, so day 0 is Monday 2023-08-14.

description: Presidential Regulation 32/2024 on publisher rights announced at National Press Day
notes: H3: favourable policy shock; connected media groups are expected to gain more. Confounded: four trading days after the general election of 2024-02-14 and one day before a cabinet change on 2024-02-21 (neither is listed; the election has no sourced URL from the 2026-11-09 pass). Time of day not confirmed.

description: Airlangga Hartarto announces his resignation as Golkar chair
notes: No sign registered: a sudden leadership vacuum weakens the party, while the expected successor was closer to the incoming president; theory does not say which dominates. Sunday, so day 0 is Monday 2024-08-12. Within five trading days of ev_perindo_joins_prabowo.

description: Perindo declares it joins the Prabowo-Gibran coalition
notes: H1: the party moves from the losing camp into the incoming governing coalition; firms tied to Perindo are expected to gain relative to other firms. Time of day not confirmed. Within five trading days of ev_airlangga_resigns.

description: European Commission proposes a 12-month delay of the EU Deforestation Regulation
notes: Falsification event: ties to Jakarta give no protection from, and no advantage under, a European rule, so no gap between connected and unconnected firms is expected. Brussels daytime release, after the Jakarta close, so day 0 is 2024-10-03.

description: Prabowo Subianto inaugurated; Red and White Cabinet announced that evening
notes: H1: the governing coalition is confirmed in office with a broad cabinet; firms tied to governing parties and the state are expected to gain relative to others. Scheduled by the electoral calendar, and candidates were summoned publicly about a week before (recalled), so anticipation_flag = 1. Sunday evening, so day 0 is Monday 2024-10-21. Confounded: the head of the new state investment agency was appointed on 2024-10-22.

description: The first Danantara launch, set for 7 November 2024, is called off the evening before
notes: Mirror of the registered Danantara sign: postponing the transfer of control delays the governance cost, so state-owned firms are expected to gain relative to others. After the close, so day 0 is 2024-11-07. Confounded: Government Regulation 47/2024 on writing off bad debts at state banks was signed on 2024-11-05, and the US election result arrived on 2024-11-06 (the latter recalled, not verified).

description: President announces that Danantara will be launched on 24 February 2025
notes: Same reasoning as the launch: the announcement made certain the move of dividend rights and control to a new fund with less parliamentary oversight, a governance cost for minority shareholders, so state-owned firms are expected to lose relative to others. Evening video speech, after the close, so day 0 is Friday 2025-02-14. Outlets date the announcement 12, 13 or 14 February; the evening of 13 February is best supported and [-1,+1] covers all three. A Saturday 2025-02-15 speech on budget savings and SOE dividends falls on day +1.

description: Danantara launched; Law 1/2025, Government Regulation 10/2025 and the decree appointing its leadership signed the same day
notes: Sign confirmed by the project owner on 2026-11-09: the launch moved dividend rights and control from the Finance Ministry to a new fund with less parliamentary oversight, which minority shareholders should price as a governance cost, so state-owned firms are expected to lose relative to others. Rejected alternative: positive (cheaper capital, protection). Scheduled since 2025-02-13 and legislated on 2025-02-04, so anticipation_flag = 1; the unanticipated counterpart is ev_danantara_date_announced. Ceremony at 10:00 WIB. Within five trading days of ev_kopdes_himbara.

description: Government decides to form village cooperatives (Koperasi Desa Merah Putih) to be financed by the state banks
notes: A lending programme assigned to the state banks by their owner is a cost borne partly by their minority shareholders; state banks are expected to lose relative to other banks. The state banks were named as funders that day per a search summary and firmly by 2025-03-10; time of day not confirmed. Within five trading days of ev_danantara_launch. Sign changed before registration: the authors' first reading was '-', the independent check derived 'ambiguous' (a directed-lending burden against privileged access to a government programme), and a disagreement is resolved as ambiguous.

description: The state's Series B shares in Mandiri, BRI, BNI and BTN are transferred to Danantara's operating holding (deed of 2025-03-22, disclosed 2025-03-24)
notes: Same sign as the launch, by the same reasoning. The transfer was required by Law 1/2025, so it is treated as anticipated (anticipation_flag = 1); the vehicle and percentages were new. Confounded: the state banks held annual meetings that replaced board members on 2025-03-24 to 2025-03-26 (dated board_seat edges in the graph). An Eid exchange closure shortly after is recalled, not verified.

description: Export levy on crude palm oil raised to 10 percent from 17 May 2025 (PMK 30/2025)
notes: H3: adverse policy shock; connected firms are expected to lose less. The regulation was signed on 5 May and promulgated on 14 May; whether the rate was public before 14 May is not confirmed. Exchange holidays on 12 and 13 May are recalled, not verified.

description: The forest-area task force hands 394,547 ha of seized plantations to state firm Agrinas Palma Nusantara
notes: H3: adverse policy shock (enforcement raises seizure risk for private plantation groups); connected firms are expected to lose less. Third and largest handover. Earlier ones on 2025-03-10 and 2025-03-26 are not listed: the first lacks a same-day source and the second sits next to the Eid closure. Time of day not confirmed.

description: Constitutional Court ruling 21/PUU-XXIII/2025 states in its reasoning that the ban on concurrent posts also covers deputy ministers
notes: If board members who hold government office are valuable to a firm, a rule that removes them is a loss: firms with sitting officials on their boards are expected to lose relative to others. The petition itself was inadmissible. Widely reported on Friday 2025-07-18, which is taken as day 0.

description: Constitutional Court ruling 128/PUU-XXIII/2025 bars deputy ministers from serving as SOE commissioners, with a two-year transition
notes: Same reasoning as ev_mk_wamen_signal: firms with sitting officials on their boards are expected to lose relative to others. First reports at 16:27 WIB, at or after the close, so day 0 is 2025-08-29. Confounded: nationwide protests escalated the same evening (recalled; no sourced URL from the 2026-11-09 pass, so the protests are not listed as an event).

description: Cabinet reshuffle replaces the finance minister and four other ministers
notes: No sign registered: the event is about fiscal credibility as much as coalition strength, and theory does not say which way connected firms should move. Announced at about 15:55 WIB, at the close, so day 0 is 2025-09-09. Within five trading days of ev_state_cash_placement.

description: Finance minister announces that about Rp200 trillion of state cash will be placed in the state banks
notes: Low-cost funding placed only with the state banks favours them over other banks; state banks are expected to gain relative to other banks. Executed on 2025-09-12. Within five trading days of ev_reshuffle_finance and ev_erick_thohir_moved.

description: Erick Thohir moved from Minister of SOEs to Minister of Youth and Sports; the SOE post is left vacant
notes: No sign registered. Theory is unclear (loss of the SOE portfolio against staying in cabinet), and a source already in the seed data reports the share reaction of the firms linked to him in its headline, so this cannot be a blind test. Within five trading days of ev_state_cash_placement.

description: DPR committee and government agree a bill that turns the Ministry of SOEs into an agency (BP BUMN)
notes: No sign registered: moving oversight from a ministry to an agency beside Danantara could tighten or loosen control over listed SOEs. This is the first clear public signal; plenary passage (2025-10-02), signing (2025-10-06) and the appointment of the agency head (2025-10-08) are later steps of the same change and are not listed. Time of day not confirmed.
